SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.notice: onlookers notice it on Perception vs TN {tn}; a magician watching −2; astrally active onlookers see it
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.centerBonus: Up to {bonus} extra success(es), if the test itself gets at least one.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.maskSeen: Seen through ({need} needed): the true aura shows within the mask.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.maskHolds: The mask holds ({need} needed): the aura reads as a mundane's.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.wardFell: has lasted its days and falls (rating 0).
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.wardDaysOver: has lasted its days: by the book it falls now.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.quickenDone: {name} sustains {spellName} for {actions} action(s), then pays {karma} Good Karma: it is quickened (the GM holds it back until the actions have passed).
SR2E.Sorcery96.Card.anchorPrep: Preparing the object (Enchanting, {dice} dice vs TN {tn}): {successes} successes, {minutes} minute(s); it is prepared either way.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Dialog.areaShape: Radius change in metres (−{shrink} to +{grow}; 2 dice a metre smaller, 1 die a metre larger)
SR2E.Sorcery96.Dialog.stack: Other spells stacked into this action (+{tn} TN each, casting and Drain)
SR2E.Sorcery96.Dialog.quickenDice: Dice used in the Spell Success Test (all sources)
SR2E.Sorcery96.Dialog.quickenHint: Sorcery + grade against the casting TN; the dice ÷ successes give the actions to sustain. Karma above the Force makes it harder to dispel. A second Drain test follows.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Why.areaTooMuch: At most {force} dice may be withheld to shape the area.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Why.areaBelowZero: The radius can't go below 0 m.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Why.fociLimit: {name} already has as many active foci as Intelligence ({intelligence}).
SR2E.Sorcery96.Why.quickenKarma: Quickening costs from {min} to {max} Good Karma.
SR2E.Sorcery96.Why.centerPerceive: {name} must be perceiving astrally to center for a spell; cast without it.
SR2E.Sorcery96.UI.gradeZeroHint: A Grade 0 initiate: initiated once, no Magic gained yet (Grimoire pp. 37–38).
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__magicD: Defaulting magical skills: cast without Sorcery by defaulting to Magical Theory, Conjuring, Enchanting or Willpower at +2 TN a web step (book) or not at all (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__areaSh: Area spells: withhold dice to shrink (2 a metre) or grow (1 a metre) the radius (book) or the Magic in metres only (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__stacki: Spell stacking: the Cast window asks for stacked spells, each adding to the casting and Drain TNs (book) or no stacking (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__stackT: Spell stacking (book): TN per stacked spell
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__notici: Noticing spellcasting: the cast card names the onlookers' Perception TN (book) or no line (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__notice: Noticing spellcasting (book): the lowest Perception TN
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__fociLi: Active foci: at most Intelligence, more refused (book), a warning (warn) or no limit (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__armorS: The Armor spell: half its successes count (book) or the usual effect step (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__wardEx: Ward days: when they run out the ward falls and the GM gets a card (book), a GM card only (card) or nothing (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__quicke: Quickening: a sustaining test, Karma from Force to twice Force and a second Drain (book) or Karma = Force at once (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__anchor: Anchoring: Karma = Force + links and an Enchanting test to prepare the object (book) or the old Karma only (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__maskin: Masking: a masked aura reads as mundane unless an initiate's secret test sees through it (book) or a TN penalty to assensing (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__center: Centering for spellcasting and Drain: offered in the Cast window (book) or penalties only (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__totemP: Totem dice: Magic Pool dice for that cast (book) or added to the casting test (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__drainT: Stat-block import: core spells with no drain code take the book's (book) or a warning only (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__dispel: Dispelling: a spell's effect shrinks with its lowered Force (book) or only the Force changes (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.SORCERY_V96__gradeZ: Grade 0 by hand: the sheet shows an "Initiated" tick at grade 0 (book) or no tick (off, v0.95.1)
